title: Authentication State Machine
hints: Switch on `(currentState, eventName)` and return the next state or nil.
Log `"ignored"` when the transition isn't legal.
jsBridge: Auth as an enum state machine (`signedOut`, `signingIn`, `signedIn(user)`, `error`) makes impossible states unrepresentable, the same idea as XState or a discriminated-union reducer in React.

compass.q: React auth state as `{ user, loading, error }` allows `loading && user`. How does the Swift enum rule that out?
Token refresh while `signedIn`: a new state, or a side effect? What happens to in-flight requests?
Enum state machine vs Firebase's auth listener callback: where does the listener feed events in?
Sign in with Apple: which states and errors must the UI handle (cancelled, credential revoked)?
